title: Design system
intro: The components that build Dodecagon, in one place. Explore real tokens, interaction states and voice patterns without connecting to a server.
foundationNote: These swatches use the current theme’s actual CSS variables. Token names describe their implementation, not a separate palette.
bodySample: Clear hierarchy leaves space for the content. Body text, supporting labels and controls share the application’s Inter typeface.
actionsNote: Variant and size names are API identifiers. Enabled specimens only increment the local counter, including the destructive-color example. No data is removed.
disabledNote: These two buttons intentionally cannot be activated. Loading is a static state specimen, not an active request.
notesExample: A quiet place to work together
inputError: Enter a display name to resolve this example error.
colorNote: This changes only the picker’s example value. It does not change your profile or the theme.
safeNote: This preview is local. No server or account data is changed.
errorRecovery: Use Try again to show the recovered example state. No network request is sent.
loadingNote: Spinner sizes are shown as static specimens. The application’s global motion reset also applies here.
emptyNote: Add a local example to see this area with content.
tabsOverview: Tabs switch between related views. Use the arrow keys to move between the available tabs.
tabsDetails: This second panel uses the same real Tabs component as the application. The unavailable tab demonstrates a disabled state.
overlayNote: Open each example to inspect placement, focus and dismissal. Escape closes overlays; focus returns to the trigger.
dialogNote: Dialogs ask for focused attention. This example has no destructive action or settings to save.
popoverNote: Popovers hold contextual information near their trigger. Select outside this example or press Escape to dismiss it.
menuSelected: Example action selected. Nothing was saved.
tooltipNote: Supporting information, available on hover or keyboard focus.
voiceNote: Real voice layout and menu components with example cards. There is no microphone, camera, media playback or voice connection. Volume is held only in this page’s memory.
voiceHelp: Select a card, right-click it, or focus it and press the context-menu key. The two cards share one local example volume; mute and slider changes stay synchronized.
scope: Coverage: shared primitives and selected voice compositions. These are interactive examples, not a full application simulation or a claim of accessibility conformance. Theme selection uses the application’s saved preference.
